$comment: Provenance manifest for source documents in data/raw/. Every PDF committed here must have an entry. 'official_source' is the canonical government URL; 'retrieved_from' is the URL the bytes were actually downloaded from (Wayback Machine snapshots of the official URLs, because dole.gov.ph serves a Cloudflare browser challenge to non-browser clients). 'ocr_file' is the tesseract/ocrmypdf-processed copy that the parsers actually read; the original scan stays as the provenance artifact. 'overrides' holds authoritative metadata passed to the parser via CLI flags, because OCR garbles identity-level fields (digits in order numbers, multi-line titles). Status values: processed | ocr_required | pending.

documents.title: Rules Implementing Articles 106 to 109 of the Labor Code, as Amended (contracting and subcontracting)

overrides.title: Rules Implementing Articles 106 to 109 of the Labor Code, as Amended

documents.notes: Official upload is a scanned image PDF with no text layer. The scan contains a stamped duplicate of the first pages; the OCR copy is sliced to the complete clean copy (original pages 2-13) via qpdf. effective_date is the document's received-stamp date '15 MAR 2017' (OCR shows the year garbled as 2317; repaired from context).

overrides.title: Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 11058 (An Act Strengthening Compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Standards and Providing Penalties for Violations Thereof)

documents.notes: Scanned image PDF, no embedded fonts. The 2020-10-22 Wayback snapshot of the same URL is truncated at exactly 1 MiB; use the 2021-03-07 snapshot recorded here. The signature block reads 'December 2018' with the day illegible under a stamp; the 06 day is taken from DOLE's published records for this order.

overrides.title: Implementing Rules and Regulations of Republic Act No. 11165, Otherwise Known as the "Telecommuting Act"

documents.notes: Scanned image PDF, no embedded fonts. ('Reulations' typo is in the official filename.) This is the telecommuting IRR; DATA_SOURCES.md previously misattributed telecommuting to a 'DO-219-21'. OCR misreads the order number on the cover as '222', hence the override.

documents.title: Labor Code of the Philippines, Renumbered (DOLE Department Advisory No. 1, Series of 2015)
documents.notes: Canonical renumbered edition. Scanned image PDF (154/154 pages empty). The 2017 DOLE edition (LaborCodeofthePhilippines20171.pdf, 141 pages, 25 MB) is also a scan and was not kept to limit repo size. Parses to 317 unique articles across Books I-VII; the repealed pre-RA 10151 Articles 130/131 reprints are dropped in favor of the renumbered provisions.
